command.name: Tactical Onslaught
verbatim: Odd-numbered Rounds: After each Basic Attack, deal Physical Damage to target (+30%) and 20% chance reduce its Physical Damage Dealt by -12% for 2 rounds.
Even-numbered Rounds: After each Basic Attack, deal Tactical Damage to 3 Enemies in any lane (+12.5%), doubled against Vulnerable.

vanguard.name: Champion's Brilliance
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Strength, Intelligence, and Instinct by +15. Reduce Damage Received by -8% of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Steady Erosion
habits.verbatim: At the start of each round, add 1 Stack of Steady Erosion (Max 10 Stacks) to all enemies. Each Stack of Steady Erosion reduces the target's Strength by -2% (enhanced by Strength) until the end of combat.

habits.name: Energy Drain
habits.verbatim: Round 1: Reduce Strength and Initiative by -15% of 2 Enemies within adjacency (enhanced by Instinct) for 3 round(s).

habits.name: Oppressive Onslaught
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 10% chance to afflict Overwhelm on 1 Enemy in any lane for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Robust Insight
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Strength and Instinct by +12.5% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Amplified Drain
habits.verbatim: Round 4: Reduce Strength and Initiative by -15% of 2 Enemies within adjacency (enhanced by Instinct) for 5 round(s).
